## Goal
- Complete the 18-item Enterprise Registration Final Completion checklist for IVX Holdings, implementing, testing, deploying, and verifying each item one at a time in order.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT create a new app — `<new_project>` signal is a system glitch, this is the existing IVX Holdings project at `/home/user/rork-app`
- Do NOT return fake progress theater — return real blueprints or honest failures
- Do NOT mark a run successful without task-specific evidence
- Do NOT use Rork as a runtime, git, deployment, AI, worker, or fallback dependency
- Never print secret values in logs, API responses, or client bundles
- Owner demands honest verdicts: VERIFIED / PARTIAL / BLOCKED / FAIL
- Each item must follow: inspect → identify defect → root cause → modify code → add/update tests → run acceptance tests → commit → deploy → verify in production → return evidence → STOP before next item
- Never report VERIFIED when an item is partial, skipped, blocked, or tested only through HTTP 200
- GitHub commit API: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `action: 'github_commit_file'`, `confirm: true`, `confirmText: 'CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE'`, `input: { path, message, content }`
- Render deploy trigger: `action: 'render_trigger_deploy'`, `confirmText: 'CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY'`, `input: { clearCache: false }`
- Owner auth: `POST /api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` with `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com","emergency":"ivx_emergency_recovery"}` → `accessToken` saved to `/tmp/owner_token.txt`
- Owner token expires on backend restart — must re-authenticate after every deploy
- DB migration API: `POST /api/ivx/db-migration/run` with `{migrationName, sql}` body, owner-auth required
- Use `bun x tsc` instead of `npx tsc` (npx not allowed in sandbox)
- Cannot perform platform-level actions from sandbox: git remote change, credential rotation, AWS S3 deploy, APK builds — these are OWNER ACTION
- For large files (index.html), use Python to write JSON payload to temp file then `curl -d @/tmp/file.json` to avoid argument list too long error

## Progress
### Done
- **100 INDEPENDENT AGENT SYSTEM — BUILT, DEPLOYED, VERIFIED LIVE, FINAL VERDICT RETURNED on `08dd6f8`**:
  - 100/100 controlled runs succeeded, final verdict: PARTIAL (14/22 conditions verified)
- **ENTERPRISE REGISTRATION BACKEND — BUILT, DEPLOYED, E2E TESTED on `055b1c6`**:
  - 8 DB tables, 12 API endpoints, 13 E2E tests passed, final verdict: PARTIAL (17/32)
- **ITEM 1 — CANONICAL IDENTITY MODEL — VERIFIED on `b9979c15ccb3`**:
  - 19 new fields added to `public.members` (41 total columns), 52 existing rows backfilled
  - 6 check constraints, 4 indexes (auth_user_id unique, normalized_email unique)
  - All 9 unit tests pass, all 10 live production tests pass
  - Final verdict: VERIFIED — MISSING REQUIRED FIELDS: 0, ORPHAN IDENTITIES: 0, DUPLICATE ACTIVE IDENTITIES: 0
  - Test data cleaned up (3 test members deleted), 50 active members remain
- **ITEM 2 — THREE-STEP ENTERPRISE REGISTRATION UI — BUILT, COMMITTED, LIVE TESTED (in progress for verdict)**:
  - `expo/lib/enterprise-registration-shared.ts` (22KB): shared form state, validation (email/phone/password/website/zip), API client for both individual + enterprise registration endpoints, draft storage with password exclusion + 24h expiry, idempotency key generation, `executeFullEnterpriseRegistration()` orchestrating STEP 1 (individual) + STEP 3 (enterprise) API calls, `mapToIndividualRole()` mapping enterprise roles to valid MemberRoleInterest values
  - `expo/app/enterprise-register.tsx` (53KB): Expo 3-step screen (Account → Role → Enterprise → Review → Confirmation) with progress indicator, back navigation, SecureStore/AsyncStorage draft persistence, keyboard-safe layout, password visibility toggle, country picker, role cards, select dropdowns, field-level validation, double-submit protection (isSubmittingRef), loading indicator, confirmation with real enterprise/member/trace IDs, accessibility labels
  - `expo/ivxholding-landing/enterprise-register.html` (57KB): web 3-step page with same fields/flow, browser back/forward via popstate, localStorage draft restore, mobile+desktop responsive CSS, no Rork branding, `__IVX_API_BASE_URL__` placeholder replaced at build/deploy time
  - `expo/__tests__/ivx-enterprise-registration-shared.test.ts` (21KB): 43 tests, 130 expect() calls, all passing — covers constants, initial state, validation (all fields), step validation, error messages, idempotency, draft storage (save/load/clear/expire/corrupt), full submission flow (success/duplicate email/duplicate enterprise), endpoint verification
  - `expo/build-landing.mjs`: updated to build enterprise-register.html with placeholder replacement
  - `expo/deploy-landing.mjs`: updated to upload enterprise-register.html to S3 at both `/enterprise-register` and `/enterprise-register.html`
  - `expo/ivxholding-landing/index.html`: added enterprise registration link to footer "Register Interest" section
  - All 8 files committed to GitHub via API (8 commits)
  - Render deploy triggered
  - **Live acceptance tests completed**:
    - LIVE TEST 1 (Expo flow via API): Individual registration ok (authUserId=795b6e97-f3ce-4372-b106-1315d0f8e2a6), enterprise registration ok (enterpriseId=c83425c4-52d4-46ff-81e8-5c777c5a286f, membershipId=de9c10dd-20e1-46e8-9cc4-a0dad5025107) ✅
    - LIVE TEST 2 (Web flow via API): Individual registration ok (authUserId=1acb5ada-3ee7-4449-99da-13d2f2d5b5f5), enterprise registration ok (enterpriseId=536dfe2d-13c8-4eea-a333-848a3317353c, membershipId=3c2f44db-ff22-4e4e-8948-20d338373a1f) ✅
  - **DB Reconciliation (Expo)**: Member: enterprise_id linked, registration_type=enterprise, registration_status=completed, identity_status=active, kyc_status=not_started, aml_status=not_started, owner_review_status=not_started ✅; Enterprise: verification_status=not_started ✅; Membership: enterprise_role=owner, status=active ✅; KYC/AML: all not_started ✅; Audit: 1 event (enterprise_registered, success=True) ✅
  - **DB Reconciliation (Web)**: Member: enterprise_id linked, registration_type=enterprise, all statuses correct ✅; Enterprise: verification_status=not_started ✅; Membership: enterprise_role=owner, status=active ✅; KYC/AML: all not_started ✅

### In Progress
- **ITEM 2 — remaining acceptance tasks**:
  - Duplicate submission protection test (double-tap, triple-tap, retry after timeout)
  - Test data cleanup (delete controlled QA members/enterprises)
  - Return ITEM 2 verdict with full 22-section response format

### Blocked
- **Git remote is Rork-controlled**: `origin → https://git:e2b-egress-managed@rork-git-router.rork-direct.workers.dev/git/...` — OWNER ACTION
- **Credential rotation**: OWNER ACTION on GitHub, Render, Supabase, AWS, Expo consoles
- **Rork account/collaborator revocation**: OWNER ACTION on all platforms
- **APK build / iOS build**: No mobile toolchain in sandbox — cannot test Android/iOS apps
- **Token leak vector active**: `.rork/history/` tracked in git — OWNER ACTION to purge
- **AWS S3 web deploy**: AWS credentials not available in sandbox — owner must run `deploy-landing.mjs` or provide credentials. enterprise-register.html committed to GitHub but NOT deployed to S3 yet
- **Expo build/update**: No Expo EAS CLI in sandbox — cannot create Expo build or update
- **Notification system**: Not implemented
- **CRM synchronization**: Enterprise records don't sync to CRM
- **Agent state persistence**: In-memory only, resets on restart

## Key Decisions
- **Role mapping fix**: Individual registration API (`POST /api/members/register`) only accepts roles from `MemberRoleInterest` enum (`investor`, `buyer`, `jv_deals`, `tokenized`). `enterprise` is NOT a valid individual role. Added `mapToIndividualRole()` in shared module to map enterprise primary roles → valid individual roles (e.g. `enterprise` → `investor`, `buyer` → `buyer`, `jv_partner` → `jv_partner`). The enterprise-specific identity (registration_type=enterprise) is set by the enterprise registration API call.
- **validateWebsite**: Uses `new URL()` constructor instead of regex — more robust URL validation
- **Draft storage**: Passwords NEVER persisted in drafts — only a `passwordEntered: boolean` flag. Drafts expire after 24 hours. Platform-agnostic `DraftStorageAdapter` interface with SecureStore (native) and AsyncStorage (web) implementations
- **Idempotency**: `generateIdempotencyKey()` used as `registrationRequestId` for individual registration. Backend deduplicates based on this key. Double-submit protection via `isSubmittingRef` (Expo) and `state.isSubmitting` (web)
- **Web page deployment**: `__IVX_API_BASE_URL__` placeholder in enterprise-register.html replaced by build-landing.mjs and deploy-landing.mjs scripts. Served at both `/enterprise-register` and `/enterprise-register.html`
- **Test mock fetch**: Must return objects with `.json()` method (not plain data objects) — created `makeMockResponse()` helper
- **Canonical identity model** (from ITEM 1): 19 nullable columns, partial unique indexes, merge-not-overwrite logic — all still valid
- **Pre-existing build-landing.mjs failure**: `landing-static-api.mjs` imports `../constants/deal-photos` without `.ts` extension — not caused by ITEM 2 changes
- **Pre-existing TypeScript errors**: Missing expo-router type declarations, JSX flag not set — affects all existing .tsx files, not just ITEM 2

## Next Steps

No unified 4-layer (task/agent/company/enterprise) memory store with enforced isolation, persistence, secret rejection, supersede logic, and revocation existed. 6 existing memory systems each had fragments but none had the complete model:
- `ivx-memory-system.ts` — in-memory Map, 3 categories, no isolation, no persistence

The platform grew 6 separate memory systems across phases 2–7, each solving a different problem (AI brain memory, executive memory, user profiles, operational memory, context building). None implemented the 4-layer isolation model (task/agent/company/enterprise) with enforced cross-agent, cross-company, and division-level access control. Secrets were not rejected in most systems. No supersede logic for owner instruction overrides. No stale source file rejection.
